scope.interpretation_summary: The margarine market encompasses the production and distribution of margarine, a butter substitute made from vegetable oils and fats. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, and various channel partners inv
scope.market_definition: The margarine market encompasses the production and distribution of margarine, a butter substitute made from vegetable oils and fats. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, and various channel partners involved in the supply chain globally.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the production of margarine from various vegetable oils and fats.
This layer includes the distribution of margarine products through various channels.
This layer involves the retailing and reselling of margarine products to end consumers.
This layer includes service providers that support the margarine supply chain.

## Common questions

### How does Instacart delivery and curbside pickup work?

Instacart makes it easy to order from your favorite stores. Shop for items from stores near you,
with a selection of more than 500 retailers and trusted local grocers across North America. Then,
Instacart will connect you with a personal shopper in your area to shop and deliver your order.
Contactless delivery is available with our “Leave at my door” option.

You can track your order’s progress and communicate with your shopper every step of the way using
the Instacart app or website.

Instacart also offers curbside pickup at select retail locations. Simply place your order and choose
a pickup time, and a shopper will prepare your order at the store.

When you get to the store, use the Instacart app to notify us. Depending on the store, a shopper or
store employee will bring the groceries to your car, or you can pick them up at the designated area.

### How much does Instacart cost?

You don’t need a membership to order with Instacart. In fact, you can even order from warehouse
clubs, like Costco, Sam’s Club, and BJ’s Wholesale Club, without a retailer club membership.

To get started, create an account, select the store you want to shop, and place your order.

Delivery: Fees start at $3.99 for same-day orders over $35. Fees vary for one-hour deliveries, club
store deliveries, and deliveries under $35.

Pickup: There may be a “pickup fee” (equivalent to a delivery fee for pickup orders) on your pick up
order.

Service fees: Service fees vary and are subject to change based on factors like location and the
number and types of items in your cart. Orders containing alcohol have a separate service fee.

With an optional Instacart+ membership, you can get $0 delivery fees* on eligible orders (grocery
and retail $10+, Costco $35+ and restaurants $25+). *Service fees apply.

### Will I pay the same price on Instacart as I would in store?

Retail partners set the prices of items on the Instacart marketplace. While many retailers offer
everyday store prices on Instacart, some retailers may set prices on the Instacart platform that are
different from in-store prices.

You can view pricing policies for each retailer on the Instacart app and website.

### What happens if something is out of stock and I need to give specific instructions?

Instacart makes it easy to communicate with your shopper. When an item you want is out-of-stock at
the store, your shopper will follow your replacement preferences.

You can set item and delivery instructions in advance, as well as chat directly with your shopper
while they shop and deliver your items. You can tell the shopper to:
* Find Best Match: By default, your shopper will use their best judgement to pick a replacement for
  your item.
* Pick Specific Replacement: You can pick a specific alternative for the shopper to purchase if your
  first choice is out-of-stock.
* Don’t Replace: For items you’d rather not replace, choose “Don’t replace” to get a refund if the
  item is out of stock.
You can update or cancel your order as long as your shopper hasn’t started shopping. If you need to
make changes after shopping has started, you can use the app or website to approve replacements or
chat with your shopper.

### What happens if there's an issue with my order?

If something isn’t right, you’ve got options. In the Instacart app or website, you can report:
* Missing items
* Incorrect items
* Damaged items
* Poor replacements
* Early/late orders

## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

### How does Instacart delivery and curbside pickup work?

Instacart makes it easy to order from your favorite stores. Shop for items from stores near you,
with a selection of more than 500 retailers and trusted local grocers across North America. Then,
Instacart will connect you with a personal shopper in your area to shop and deliver your order.
Contactless delivery is available with our “Leave at my door” option.

You can track your order’s progress and communicate with your shopper every step of the way using
the Instacart app or website.

Instacart also offers curbside pickup at select retail locations. Simply place your order and choose
a pickup time, and a shopper will prepare your order at the store.

When you get to the store, use the Instacart app to notify us. Depending on the store, a shopper or
store employee will bring the groceries to your car, or you can pick them up at the designated area.

### How much does Instacart cost?

You don’t need a membership to order with Instacart. In fact, you can even order from warehouse
clubs, like Costco, Sam’s Club, and BJ’s Wholesale Club, without a retailer club membership.

To get started, create an account, select the store you want to shop, and place your order.

Delivery: Fees start at $3.99 for same-day orders over $35. Fees vary for one-hour deliveries, club
store deliveries, and deliveries under $35.

Pickup: There may be a “pickup fee” (equivalent to a delivery fee for pickup orders) on your pick up
order.

With an optional Instacart+ membership, you can get $0 delivery fees* on eligible orders (grocery
and retail $10+, Costco $35+ and restaurants $25+). *Service fees apply.

### Will I pay the same price on Instacart as I would in store?

Retail partners set the prices of items on the Instacart marketplace. While many retailers offer
everyday store prices on Instacart, some retailers may set prices on the Instacart platform that are
different from in-store prices.

You can view pricing policies for each retailer on the Instacart app and website.

### What happens if something is out of stock and I need to give specific instructions?

Instacart makes it easy to communicate with your shopper. When an item you want is out-of-stock at
the store, your shopper will follow your replacement preferences.

You can set item and delivery instructions in advance, as well as chat directly with your shopper
while they shop and deliver your items. You can tell the shopper to:
* Find Best Match: By default, your shopper will use their best judgement to pick a replacement for
  your item.
* Pick Specific Replacement: You can pick a specific alternative for the shopper to purchase if your
  first choice is out-of-stock.
* Don’t Replace: For items you’d rather not replace, choose “Don’t replace” to get a refund if the
  item is out of stock.
You can update or cancel your order as long as your shopper hasn’t started shopping. If you need to
make changes after shopping has started, you can use the app or website to approve replacements or
chat with your shopper.

### What happens if there's an issue with my order?

If something isn’t right, you’ve got options. In the Instacart app or website, you can report:
* Missing items
* Incorrect items
* Damaged items
* Poor replacements
* Early/late orders

Innovation and Inspiration is Our Story

## A Legacy Built on Butter, Not Birds

We’re not the turkey company, but [our story ][81]does start there. Our founder, Leo Peters, made
sure to retain the rights to the Butterball name when he sold the turkey patents in the 1960s, eager
to translate his innovative mind and high-quality food production experience into the realm of
butter and custom flavors. 

That mindset continues today with second-generation owner Mark Peters, who has a trendsetting
passion for flavor, innovation, and imagination of the culinary arts to produce products that
greatly enhance your brand.

### R&D Decision Makers

We provide R&D decision makers with access to accurate, connected data so they can quickly

We help Innovation teams discover the emerging technology areas, evaluate technological maturity,

millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

We help Business Development teams identify startups and new entrants with disruptive technologies,
and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.
Equipped with these insights, BD teams can make informed decisions about which companies to
collaborate with.

analyze and make sense of market trends, disruptive technology, the competitive landscape, and more.

you don’t miss important insights that could impact your innovation strategy.

## Functional fats

Funktionelle fedtstoffer der løfter bagning og madlavning fra godt til bedre. Vores sortiment
omfatter smør, smørblandinger, margariner, smørbare løsninger, vegetabilske olier og specialfedt.
Fås som clean label, palmeoliefri, økologisk, plantebaseret, hybrid samt fuldt mejeribaserede

ydeevne og funktionalitet er afgørende.

holdbarhed, stabil performance og nem anvendelse på tværs af detail, foodservice og industrielle
applikationer.

bakker og is-kantiner – fyldt med smage og inclusions som cookie dough, lakrids og funky jams.

# EXPERTS IN MARGARINES

AND MUCH MORE!

### MISSION, VISION AND VALUES

###### THE BASIS OF OUR COMPANY

 

Our Mission, Vision and Values govern our daily activities, harness our international vocation as a
leader and guide us towards ethical behaviour to create value sustainably. For us, leaders should be
committed to the principles of ethics, safety, quality and, of course,… the Environment.

Of course, all these principles govern the ABCs of our code of values where honesty, enthusiasm,
improvement and teamwork are indispensable to achieving these key principles.

 

##### [DISCOVER MORE][49]

Gracomsa Alimentaria, as the flagship of the Nuova Secac Group’s food division, was launched in 1982
as a company dedicated to producing margarines, oils and speciality fats for the food industry. Over
these three decades of activity we have extended our lines of business towards other sectors with
the addition of new products in our catalogue.

 

Based in Valencia, it is the only 100% Spanish company that operates in the market of fats for the
food industry, facing off against large multi-brand multinational companies with own their brands.
It also develops customised products that conform to specific product requirements, conditions, and
objectives that have been requested.

### SUSTAINABILITY

At Gracomsa we have committed ourselves to promoting and contributing to sustainable development in
the company and all the sectors that are important to us. Said commitments are featured in the
Sustainability Plan which, in turn, is included in the Company’s Strategy Plan, with policies that
have been developed from an approach that includes environmental and economical aspects, fair
payments for our workers and collaborators to create an ethical economy that generates, and does not
detract, value.

 

##### [DISCOVER MORE][50]

Currently, Gracomsa has facilities with a production capacity of more than 60,000 tons of
margarines, oils and speciality fats per year. We sell to all sectors, from the food industry, to
the Horeca, Bakery and Retail industries, with a new production centre (Doccas Food), a cutting-edge
plant that is within the so-called industry 4.0. Doccas Food represents a new generation of
production leaders in Europe that embraces the smart factory concept which enables the highest
standards of quality and food control to be reached.

## All The Sauces Your Menu Needs
## For Total Convenience

Alright, let’s talk about the 1xBet APK download in Nepal. It’s 2026, and if you’re not betting from
your phone, what are you even doing? Seriously.

The 1xBet app, available for both Android and iOS, has become hugely popular. Nepali players are all
over it. Why? Well, convenience is king. And this app delivers big time.

Downloading the APK is pretty straightforward. First, hit that download button on their site. You
know, the big green one. Then, you might need to tweak your phone’s settings to allow installations
from “unknown sources.” Don’t sweat [https://1xbetapp-nepal.com][26] it, it’s a one-time thing.
Finally, find the downloaded file and install it. Bingo! You’re in.

What’s so great about it anyway? The 1xBet app offers instant withdrawals, which is a huge plus.
Nobody wants to wait weeks to get their winnings! You also get access to exclusive video broadcasts.
Watch the game and bet on it live, all from your phone. Pretty cool, right?

And they’ve got everything covered, from football to cricket, even esports. In fact, I heard their
esports betting grew by almost 40% in Nepal last year! No joke. You’ve got access to all sorts of
sports markets that might not be available on other platforms. What’s not to love?

I actually remember back in January 2025, a mate of mine, he won big on a cricket match, using the
1xBet app, and had the money in his account within hours. He was absolutely buzzing! Good times.

Security is also a major concern for most people. 1xBet claims the app is completely safe. It’s

# Accueil


### Margarine Thibault, Situé à Trois-Rivières en Mauricie, est le seul fabricant québécois de
### margarine et tartinades.

### nous faisons des produits de qualité qui se démarquent depuis plus de 100 ans.

[IMG_4921.jpg]

## [Supermarché][50]

Bonne à tartiner, bonne à cuisiner, bonne pour la santé et surtout bonne au goût! Nos margarines
sont parfaites pour toutes vos recettes. 

Fabriquée sans OGM et végétalienne, notre Nuvel est le seul vrai choix pour un déjeuner santé.
Découvrez aussi nos margarines Bergeron et Thibault.

## [Hotels, Restos et institutions][51]

Nous savons que le travail en cuisine est aussi exigant qu'important. Notre vaste gamme de produits
santé — consciencieuse des intolérances et allergies — facilitera votre travail. Vous trouverez ici
un aperçu détaillé de nos produits.

[IMG_5351.jpg]

## [Boulangerie et pâtisserie][52]

Nous fabriquons bien plus que des margarines, tartinades et oléobeurres pour le commerce au détail;
nous sommes derrière un important nombre de produits de boulangerie-pâtisserie consommés chaque jour
par des milliers de québécois et de canadiens!

## [Sur mesure][53]

Mettez notre laboratoire et notre savoir-faire à votre service!

Margarine Thibault développe des tartinades et margarines sur mesure pour les marques privées du
commerce au détail et de l'hôtellerie.

# Accueil


### Margarine Thibault, Situé à Trois-Rivières en Mauricie, est le seul fabricant québécois de
### margarine et tartinades.

### nous faisons des produits de qualité qui se démarquent depuis plus de 100 ans.

[IMG_4921.jpg]

## [Supermarché][50]

Bonne à tartiner, bonne à cuisiner, bonne pour la santé et surtout bonne au goût! Nos margarines
sont parfaites pour toutes vos recettes. 

Fabriquée sans OGM et végétalienne, notre Nuvel est le seul vrai choix pour un déjeuner santé.
Découvrez aussi nos margarines Bergeron et Thibault.

## [Hotels, Restos et institutions][51]

Nous savons que le travail en cuisine est aussi exigant qu'important. Notre vaste gamme de produits
santé — consciencieuse des intolérances et allergies — facilitera votre travail. Vous trouverez ici
un aperçu détaillé de nos produits.

[IMG_5351.jpg]

## [Boulangerie et pâtisserie][52]

Nous fabriquons bien plus que des margarines, tartinades et oléobeurres pour le commerce au détail;
nous sommes derrière un important nombre de produits de boulangerie-pâtisserie consommés chaque jour
par des milliers de québécois et de canadiens!

## [Sur mesure][53]

Mettez notre laboratoire et notre savoir-faire à votre service!

Margarine Thibault développe des tartinades et margarines sur mesure pour les marques privées du
commerce au détail et de l'hôtellerie.

## A word from our CEO

When my father, Gulamabbas Dewji, started the MeTL Group in the 1970s it was merely a small trading
company with a bold vision and an insurmountable commitment to providing great value products at
affordable prices. Since I joined my father in the business in 1999, our company has grown in leaps
and bounds to become a major economic powerhouse in East Africa. And yet we remain insatiably
committed to that vision. We have developed new products, introduced new services, and invested in
new technology and knowledge while continuing to offer our buyers and consumers value for money.

CEO & President

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

## **Notre vision
## **

> **Royale Lacroix** puise loin [dans son passé][18], son expérience du travail de la margarine et
> des matières grasses afin de proposer une gamme étendue de [produits pour la table, la
> cuisine][19], [les professionnels de l’industrie][20] dont la biscuiterie, la pâtisserie, la
> boulangerie artisanale et industrielle.
> 
> Au travers de notre expertise, nous proposons des solutions personnalisées à ces différents
> secteurs d’activité. L’adéquation permanente de son outil de production aux exigences spécifiques
> de ses clients, se traduit par une progression constante sur les différents marchés
> internationaux.
> 
> Plus que jamais, nous recherchons l’excellence par la sélection des matières premières, avec le
> souci de la [qualité totale][21] et du maintien d’une culture de la sécurité alimentaire. Dans
> cette optique de qualité, la direction a mis en place une politique visant à assurer la croissance
> et la pérennité de la société et à doter celle-ci d’un avantage concurrentiel durable.
> 
> N’hésitez pas à nous [contacter][22] pour toute question relative à vos produits, innovation, nous
> serions particulièrement honoré de contribuer à votre dynamique d’entreprise.

## **Notre vision
## **

> **Royale Lacroix** puise loin [dans son passé][18], son expérience du travail de la margarine et
> des matières grasses afin de proposer une gamme étendue de [produits pour la table, la
> cuisine][19], [les professionnels de l’industrie][20] dont la biscuiterie, la pâtisserie, la
> boulangerie artisanale et industrielle.
> 
> Au travers de notre expertise, nous proposons des solutions personnalisées à ces différents
> secteurs d’activité. L’adéquation permanente de son outil de production aux exigences spécifiques
> de ses clients, se traduit par une progression constante sur les différents marchés
> internationaux.
> 
> Plus que jamais, nous recherchons l’excellence par la sélection des matières premières, avec le
> souci de la [qualité totale][21] et du maintien d’une culture de la sécurité alimentaire. Dans
> cette optique de qualité, la direction a mis en place une politique visant à assurer la croissance
> et la pérennité de la société et à doter celle-ci d’un avantage concurrentiel durable.
> 
> N’hésitez pas à nous [contacter][22] pour toute question relative à vos produits, innovation, nous
> serions particulièrement honoré de contribuer à votre dynamique d’entreprise.

## Dedicated to **Scraped surface heat exchanger**

Hebei Shipu Machinery Technology Co., Ltd. (SHIPUTEC), A professional manufacturer of Scraped
surface heat exchanger, integrating design, manufacturing, technical support and related after-sale
service, devotes to providing turn-key solution for customers in dairy industry, such as Butter,
Margarine, Shortening, Ghee, Milk Powder, and other dairy product.

Over the course of 20 years of development, based on the European and USA technology of Scraped
Surface Heat Exchangers, SHIPUTEC has developed a series of Dairy Product processing and packaging
equipment, such as Scraped Surface Heat Exchangers(SSHEs), Votator, Super Votator, Pin Rotor
machine, Filling Machines, Sheet Margarine Packaging Line, Block Margarine Packaging Line, Tub
Filling Machine and etc., which has applied for numerous national trade marks and invention patents.

SHIPUTEC has established long-term strategic partnerships with world-renowned enterprises, such as**
Fonterra, Puratos, Willmar Kerry, Unilever, Pacific, DKSH** and etc., and provided high-quality
equipment and services to customers, which are highly praised by the customers.

SHIPUTEC also set up branch offices or agents in countries such as **Russia, Indonesia, Ethiopia,
Angola, Mozambique, and South Africa**, which can provide customers with faster technical services.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

## PRODUCTS

Before you is a story about heritage. A story of family, community and history. Explore and read all
about who we are, our product range and offering in the Oil and Margarine Industry.

[ View Our Product Range ][36]

## Our Heritage

Unity Food Products (Pty) Ltd was established in 2002 and has a proud tradition of producing
high-quality, pure sunflower cooking oils and margarines that continue to make its way into South
African homes.

Unity’s mission is to curate products that will have a unique offering for every South African and
to promote a more balanced lifestyle. Unity’s products have become household names that are trusted
and loved.

[ Read More ][37]

## Our Community

Being part of a community means uniting together with trust, loyalty and connection. Unity wants to
build a community around their ethos, bringing South Africans together and building brand trust and
loyalty.

Learning about our customer’s needs and creating a platform that welcomes all with open arms. Giving
back to those in need is our social responsibility which we want to grow through community outreach
programmes. Working together allows us to learn, grow and develop.

## Building a community, by creating a family.

Who we are as a company, our vision, our philosophies, values and social responsibilities.

Our family of sunflower oil and margarine products have made their way into many South Africa homes,
including products for catering and bulk-buying.

## Description of VidMate

Vidmate app is a free video downloader for Android that works with many different social platforms,
including YouTube, TikTok, WhatsApp, among others.



With Vidmate, you'll be able to download any multimedia material (videos, pictures, or audio files)
to your Android device at no cost. Just with a couple of taps, you can get that amazing YouTube
music video, useful Facebook tutorials, or popular TikTok recipes or choreographies in just a few
seconds. With this amazing feature, you'll be able to play them later without using any allowance of
your data plan. This is a great way of saving data and money while having your favorite content
available at all times.



Once you download the Vidmate app, you'll realize it's compatible with a lot of different and
popular platforms, including YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp Status, Dailymotion, Vimeo,
Twitter, LiveLeak, Instagram... You've got almost everything. Also, Vidmate works on Internet
browsers, so feel free to watch, enjoy and download your favorite content directly from your
browser.



Vidmate is an extremely easy-to-use tool. You'll realize that a tutorial is not needed and, once you
download it and open it, you'll easily understand the way Vidmate works and you'll start downloading
videos, pictures, and songs in a matter of seconds. The experience is so smooth that you can
download several videos at the same time. This way you'll save some time and, as said, a lot of data
from your mobile data plan! You can also, pause and resume the download process in case you're Wi-Fi
connection is interrupted for any reason. These downloads take place in the background, but you'll
always be able to check the progress at any time.



The amount of formats you can download videos on is amazing, from lower-resolution 2K clips to
amazing 4K ones, Vidmate will for sure meet your quality requirements and adapt to your needs. This
option is not only crucial for you to manage your device memory but also to enjoy the content in the
best way possible on your device. Vidmate offers an automatic system to adjust videos to best suit
your screen size. This way you can relax and let Vidmate make this decision for you!



Vidmate app also works with other types of content apart from videos, including pictures and audio.
You can download high-resolution pictures and memes very quickly but also songs in a lot of formats,
including mp3! If you were worried about using too much data to listen to your favorite playlist,
you can just download those songs at a very high speed via WiFi to enjoy them without using your
allowance!



Your favorite YouTube video downloader is not only easy-to-use, comfortable, convenient, and fast,
but also a safe tool. With Vidmate you'll enjoy amazing features to download your favorite content
to your Android device while keeping it safe at all times. And it's also free to download and use!



Vidmate also features a subscribe option that allows you to follow content that you like and to keep
you updated with your favorite influencers and Internet stars. Also, if you need new ideas, you can
just use the Discover channel and find out the latest trends around the globe!



On top of all those social media platforms, Vidmate app also offers you the possibility to record
Live TV and series, including very popular channels such as Zee TV and Channel V, in a lot of
languages and from all over the world.



One of the most useful and popular tools on the internet is waiting for you! Download Vidmate to get
your favorite videos to your Android device in minutes easily and comfortably!

## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

" بهشـــــــــهر "

فعالیت های بازرگانی گروه صنایع بهشهر در سال ۱۳۲۳ با تاسیس شرکت سهامی بازرگانی آرین ( سهامی خاص)
نخستین شرکت بازرگانی وابسته به هلدینگ آغاز گردید و سپس در سال ۱۳۳۰ فعالیت‌های تولیدی خود را شروع
نمود.
این شرکت در ۱۴ دی ماه سال ۱۳۴۹ با نام "شرکت سهامی خاص توسعه صنایع آرین" در اداره ثبت شرکت‌ها و مال

## A Legacy Built on Butter, Not Birds

We’re not the turkey company, but [our story ][81]does start there. Our founder, Leo Peters, made
sure to retain the rights to the Butterball name when he sold the turkey patents in the 1960s, eager
to translate his innovative mind and high-quality food production experience into the realm of
butter and custom flavors. 

That mindset continues today with second-generation owner Mark Peters, who has a trendsetting
passion for flavor, innovation, and imagination of the culinary arts to produce products that
greatly enhance your brand.

# Adapt fast, produce smart

## Om Dragsbæk

Dragsbæk er en dansk fødevareproducent med ekspertise i funktionelle fedtstoffer og drikkevarer.

Vi rykker hurtigt, tilpasser os markedet og sætter en ære i at levere de bedst mulige løsninger til
vores partnere i industri, bageri, foodservice og detail.

## Functional fats

Funktionelle fedtstoffer der løfter bagning og madlavning fra godt til bedre. Vores sortiment
omfatter smør, smørblandinger, margariner, smørbare løsninger, vegetabilske olier og specialfedt.
Fås som clean label, palmeoliefri, økologisk, plantebaseret, hybrid samt fuldt mejeribaserede
løsninger. Designet til professionelle bagerier, køkkener og industriel fødevareproduktion, hvor
ydeevne og funktionalitet er afgørende.

[ Læs mere ][53]

## Beverage & Nutrition

Vores sortiment dækker plantebaserede og mejeribaserede drikke, barista‑produkter, sportsdrikke,
smagssatte drikke samt madlavningsfløder. Alle produkter er UHT‑behandlede og udviklet til lang
holdbarhed, stabil performance og nem anvendelse på tværs af detail, foodservice og industrielle
applikationer. 

[ Læs mere ][54]

## Ice Cream & Desserts

Vi sætter baren for is og desserter på det Nordiske marked. Vi tilbyder plantebaseret, mejeribaseret
og økologisk is samt mousser og desserter i en lang række formater. Fra vafler, ispinde og bægre til
bakker og is-kantiner – fyldt med smage og inclusions som cookie dough, lakrids og funky jams.

# EXPERTS IN MARGARINES

AND MUCH MORE!

### MISSION, VISION AND VALUES

###### THE BASIS OF OUR COMPANY

 

Our Mission, Vision and Values govern our daily activities, harness our international vocation as a
leader and guide us towards ethical behaviour to create value sustainably. For us, leaders should be
committed to the principles of ethics, safety, quality and, of course,… the Environment.

Of course, all these principles govern the ABCs of our code of values where honesty, enthusiasm,
improvement and teamwork are indispensable to achieving these key principles.

 

##### [DISCOVER MORE][49]

Gracomsa Alimentaria, as the flagship of the Nuova Secac Group’s food division, was launched in 1982
as a company dedicated to producing margarines, oils and speciality fats for the food industry. Over
these three decades of activity we have extended our lines of business towards other sectors with
the addition of new products in our catalogue.

 

Based in Valencia, it is the only 100% Spanish company that operates in the market of fats for the
food industry, facing off against large multi-brand multinational companies with own their brands.
It also develops customised products that conform to specific product requirements, conditions, and
objectives that have been requested.

### SUSTAINABILITY

At Gracomsa we have committed ourselves to promoting and contributing to sustainable development in
the company and all the sectors that are important to us. Said commitments are featured in the
Sustainability Plan which, in turn, is included in the Company’s Strategy Plan, with policies that
have been developed from an approach that includes environmental and economical aspects, fair
payments for our workers and collaborators to create an ethical economy that generates, and does not
detract, value.

 

##### [DISCOVER MORE][50]

Currently, Gracomsa has facilities with a production capacity of more than 60,000 tons of
margarines, oils and speciality fats per year. We sell to all sectors, from the food industry, to
the Horeca, Bakery and Retail industries, with a new production centre (Doccas Food), a cutting-edge
plant that is within the so-called industry 4.0. Doccas Food represents a new generation of
production leaders in Europe that embraces the smart factory concept which enables the highest
standards of quality and food control to be reached.

## CONCEPT

By creating a unique collection of innovative ingredients for GRANDPRO baking, RUSAGRO Group experts
focused on the current needs of confectionery artists working in the HoReCa field or developing
their own business.

Impeccable quality, technological efficiency, economic efficiency, new ideas for pastry chefs and
your creative freedom are the fundamental values on which the GRANDPRO brand concept is based.

GRANDPRO is not only modern Russian—made products, but also a unique professional development
program that includes expert technological assistance to pastry chefs, educational projects, and the
exchange of experience and ideas. GRANDPRO helps you achieve success and improve in your favorite
profession!

## GRANDPRO MARGARINES

**GRANDPRO premium margarines** are an innovative line of high-tech plant-based ingredients for
pastry manufactures, restaurants, coffee shops, bakeries.

We make GRANDPRO margarines from high-quality natural raw materials, with no animal fats and
preservatives. GRANDPRO margarines are suitable for creating dairy-free desserts, lean baked
goodies, healthy lifestyle diets, as well as a wide range of classic bakery and pastries.

Working with GRAND PRO margarines, you are always confident in the stable quality of your products,
their long shelf life and aesthetic appearance.

To meet customer needs and help you to cook always great, we have created five special margarines
for various technological applications: **GRANDPRO Cake, GRANDPRO Tart, GRANDPRO Cream, GRANDPRO
Croissant** and ** GRANDPRO Eclair** covering a full range of pastry recipes.

CAKE

For cakes, Easter bread, rolls, pies, and muffins

For shortcrust pastries

[подробнее »][39]
CROISSANT

For all of puff pastry types

[подробнее »][40]
CREAM

For pastry creams and fillings

[подробнее »][41]
ECLAIR

For creams and fillings of cakes, pastries, souffles

[подробнее »][42]

*The price does not include delivery; the minimum order is 1 pack (10 kg).

[GRANDPRO CATALOG][43]
[CATALOG »][44]

## GRANDPRO BUTTER

**GRANDPRO Butter for professionals — ** butter for those who create and prefer traditions, or for
those who reinvent baking in a new way. We support you in your quest for perfection. **GRANDPRO
Butter ** has many advantages that make it indispensable for puff pastry and rich pastries,
shortcrust pastry, creams. The butter is ideal for all types of sauces, emulsions and other types of
culinary products. It is available in 5 kg blocks, a practical size for your production. Price: on
request

## GRANDPRO whipping paste

**GRANDPRO paste** is a complex food additive with a high concentration of working substances. It
contains emulsifiers of natural origin that are safe for human health. When preparing various types
of dough and creams, **GRANDPRO paste** increases aeration and stability of whipped masses.

**GRANDPRO paste** is a multifunctional ingredient and has proven itself well in various
applications, including the manufacture of biscuits, muffins, muffins and cakes; sweet biscuits;
custard and fruit and berry creams; semi-finished products for freezing. The paste is economical to
use.

It is available in 2 kg plastic buckets.

The cost starts from 300 rubles/kg excluding delivery.

# Accueil


### Margarine Thibault, Situé à Trois-Rivières en Mauricie, est le seul fabricant québécois de
### margarine et tartinades.

### nous faisons des produits de qualité qui se démarquent depuis plus de 100 ans.

[IMG_4921.jpg]

## [Supermarché][50]

Bonne à tartiner, bonne à cuisiner, bonne pour la santé et surtout bonne au goût! Nos margarines
sont parfaites pour toutes vos recettes. 

Fabriquée sans OGM et végétalienne, notre Nuvel est le seul vrai choix pour un déjeuner santé.
Découvrez aussi nos margarines Bergeron et Thibault.

## [Hotels, Restos et institutions][51]

Nous savons que le travail en cuisine est aussi exigant qu'important. Notre vaste gamme de produits
santé — consciencieuse des intolérances et allergies — facilitera votre travail. Vous trouverez ici
un aperçu détaillé de nos produits.

[IMG_5351.jpg]

## [Boulangerie et pâtisserie][52]

Nous fabriquons bien plus que des margarines, tartinades et oléobeurres pour le commerce au détail;
nous sommes derrière un important nombre de produits de boulangerie-pâtisserie consommés chaque jour
par des milliers de québécois et de canadiens!

## [Sur mesure][53]

Mettez notre laboratoire et notre savoir-faire à votre service!

Margarine Thibault développe des tartinades et margarines sur mesure pour les marques privées du
commerce au détail et de l'hôtellerie.

# Accueil


### Margarine Thibault, Situé à Trois-Rivières en Mauricie, est le seul fabricant québécois de
### margarine et tartinades.

### nous faisons des produits de qualité qui se démarquent depuis plus de 100 ans.

[IMG_4921.jpg]

## [Supermarché][50]

Bonne à tartiner, bonne à cuisiner, bonne pour la santé et surtout bonne au goût! Nos margarines
sont parfaites pour toutes vos recettes. 

Fabriquée sans OGM et végétalienne, notre Nuvel est le seul vrai choix pour un déjeuner santé.
Découvrez aussi nos margarines Bergeron et Thibault.

## [Hotels, Restos et institutions][51]

Nous savons que le travail en cuisine est aussi exigant qu'important. Notre vaste gamme de produits
santé — consciencieuse des intolérances et allergies — facilitera votre travail. Vous trouverez ici
un aperçu détaillé de nos produits.

[IMG_5351.jpg]

## [Boulangerie et pâtisserie][52]

Nous fabriquons bien plus que des margarines, tartinades et oléobeurres pour le commerce au détail;
nous sommes derrière un important nombre de produits de boulangerie-pâtisserie consommés chaque jour
par des milliers de québécois et de canadiens!

## [Sur mesure][53]

Mettez notre laboratoire et notre savoir-faire à votre service!

Margarine Thibault développe des tartinades et margarines sur mesure pour les marques privées du
commerce au détail et de l'hôtellerie. 

Des idées? Nous, on en a!

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

## **Notre vision
## **

> **Royale Lacroix** puise loin [dans son passé][18], son expérience du travail de la margarine et
> des matières grasses afin de proposer une gamme étendue de [produits pour la table, la
> cuisine][19], [les professionnels de l’industrie][20] dont la biscuiterie, la pâtisserie, la
> boulangerie artisanale et industrielle.
> 
> Au travers de notre expertise, nous proposons des solutions personnalisées à ces différents
> secteurs d’activité. L’adéquation permanente de son outil de production aux exigences spécifiques
> de ses clients, se traduit par une progression constante sur les différents marchés
> internationaux.
> 
> Plus que jamais, nous recherchons l’excellence par la sélection des matières premières, avec le
> souci de la [qualité totale][21] et du maintien d’une culture de la sécurité alimentaire. Dans
> cette optique de qualité, la direction a mis en place une politique visant à assurer la croissance
> et la pérennité de la société et à doter celle-ci d’un avantage concurrentiel durable.
> 
> N’hésitez pas à nous [contacter][22] pour toute question relative à vos produits, innovation, nous
> serions particulièrement honoré de contribuer à votre dynamique d’entreprise.

production capacity and cost efficiency.

Which is the Healthier Choice for You?

#### BUTTER VS. SPREADS

#### Churning Cream

Traditional dietary staple made by churning cream

#### Milk Fat

As a concentrated source of milk fat, it’s mostly composed of saturated fat.

#### Overpowering Flavor

Butter possesses a salty and overpowering flavor

#### Modern-age Recipe

Processed modern-age recipe that is often recommended as a butter replacement

#### Lower Cholesterol

Spreads are made from vegetable oils, which contain polyunsaturated fats that can lower the “bad”
cholesterol

#### Milder Flavor

Spreads has a milder flavor that doesn’t overpower the primary taste of the recipe

## Dedicated to **Scraped surface heat exchanger**

Hebei Shipu Machinery Technology Co., Ltd. (SHIPUTEC), A professional manufacturer of Scraped
surface heat exchanger, integrating design, manufacturing, technical support and related after-sale
service, devotes to providing turn-key solution for customers in dairy industry, such as Butter,
Margarine, Shortening, Ghee, Milk Powder, and other dairy product.

Over the course of 20 years of development, based on the European and USA technology of Scraped
Surface Heat Exchangers, SHIPUTEC has developed a series of Dairy Product processing and packaging
equipment, such as Scraped Surface Heat Exchangers(SSHEs), Votator, Super Votator, Pin Rotor
machine, Filling Machines, Sheet Margarine Packaging Line, Block Margarine Packaging Line, Tub
Filling Machine and etc., which has applied for numerous national trade marks and invention patents.

SHIPUTEC has established long-term strategic partnerships with world-renowned enterprises, such as**
Fonterra, Puratos, Willmar Kerry, Unilever, Pacific, DKSH** and etc., and provided high-quality
equipment and services to customers, which are highly praised by the customers.

SHIPUTEC also set up branch offices or agents in countries such as **Russia, Indonesia, Ethiopia,
Angola, Mozambique, and South Africa**, which can provide customers with faster technical services.

and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

## Our Heritage

Unity Food Products (Pty) Ltd was established in 2002 and has a proud tradition of producing
high-quality, pure sunflower cooking oils and margarines that continue to make its way into South
African homes.

Unity’s mission is to curate products that will have a unique offering for every South African and
to promote a more balanced lifestyle. Unity’s products have become household names that are trusted
and loved.

[ Read More ][37]

## Our Community

Being part of a community means uniting together with trust, loyalty and connection. Unity wants to
build a community around their ethos, bringing South Africans together and building brand trust and
loyalty.

Learning about our customer’s needs and creating a platform that welcomes all with open arms. Giving
back to those in need is our social responsibility which we want to grow through community outreach
programmes. Working together allows us to learn, grow and develop.

## Description of VidMate

Vidmate app is a free video downloader for Android that works with many different social platforms,
including YouTube, TikTok, WhatsApp, among others.



With Vidmate, you'll be able to download any multimedia material (videos, pictures, or audio files)
to your Android device at no cost. Just with a couple of taps, you can get that amazing YouTube
music video, useful Facebook tutorials, or popular TikTok recipes or choreographies in just a few
seconds. With this amazing feature, you'll be able to play them later without using any allowance of
your data plan. This is a great way of saving data and money while having your favorite content
available at all times.



Once you download the Vidmate app, you'll realize it's compatible with a lot of different and
popular platforms, including YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp Status, Dailymotion, Vimeo,
Twitter, LiveLeak, Instagram... You've got almost everything. Also, Vidmate works on Internet
browsers, so feel free to watch, enjoy and download your favorite content directly from your
browser.



Vidmate is an extremely easy-to-use tool. You'll realize that a tutorial is not needed and, once you
download it and open it, you'll easily understand the way Vidmate works and you'll start downloading
videos, pictures, and songs in a matter of seconds. The experience is so smooth that you can
download several videos at the same time. This way you'll save some time and, as said, a lot of data
from your mobile data plan! You can also, pause and resume the download process in case you're Wi-Fi
connection is interrupted for any reason. These downloads take place in the background, but you'll
always be able to check the progress at any time.



The amount of formats you can download videos on is amazing, from lower-resolution 2K clips to
amazing 4K ones, Vidmate will for sure meet your quality requirements and adapt to your needs. This
option is not only crucial for you to manage your device memory but also to enjoy the content in the
best way possible on your device. Vidmate offers an automatic system to adjust videos to best suit
your screen size. This way you can relax and let Vidmate make this decision for you!



Vidmate app also works with other types of content apart from videos, including pictures and audio.
You can download high-resolution pictures and memes very quickly but also songs in a lot of formats,
including mp3! If you were worried about using too much data to listen to your favorite playlist,
you can just download those songs at a very high speed via WiFi to enjoy them without using your
allowance!



Your favorite YouTube video downloader is not only easy-to-use, comfortable, convenient, and fast,
but also a safe tool. With Vidmate you'll enjoy amazing features to download your favorite content
to your Android device while keeping it safe at all times. And it's also free to download and use!



Vidmate also features a subscribe option that allows you to follow content that you like and to keep
you updated with your favorite influencers and Internet stars. Also, if you need new ideas, you can
just use the Discover channel and find out the latest trends around the globe!



On top of all those social media platforms, Vidmate app also offers you the possibility to record
Live TV and series, including very popular channels such as Zee TV and Channel V, in a lot of
languages and from all over the world.



One of the most useful and popular tools on the internet is waiting for you! Download Vidmate to get
your favorite videos to your Android device in minutes easily and comfortably!
